descriptionChirho: A Hebrew proper name meaning 'YHWH has been gracious,' borne by several individuals in the Hebrew Bible including a Levitical gatekeeper and military officers. Variant transliterations include Jehohanan, Johanan, and Yochanan (eng 'Yehochanan/Jehohanan,' spa 'Johanán/Yehoḥanan,' arb 'يَهُوحَانَانُ/يُوحَانَان,' kor '여호하난/요하난,' swa 'Yehohanani/Yohanani,' hin 'यहोहानान/योखानान'). All clusters are the same proper noun in different grammatical frames (nominative, with conjunction, variant spelling).
